integrity: The analytical argument, not finite numerical experiments, supports the all-dimensional theorem. No independent review or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: A homogeneous directed competition cascade; dimension n >= 2, positive damping and coupling; Euclidean infinitesimal single-coordinate perturbations only. Finite positive interventions and arbitrary network geometries are not proved. Historical priority remains provisional; full text of Chen and Cohen (2001) was not accessible for direct detailed comparison.
title: Sharp single-site amplification thresholds in globally attracting competition cascades
